construction.implementation_origin: Original integrated reference implementation built within the isolated directory

shared_schema.input: Strict JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, fixture_label, industry=Manufacturing, work_orders, telemetry_csv, quality_inspections, maintenance_logs, feedback.
shared_schema.normalization: ERP/MES-style work-order JSON remains structured. Exact-header time-series CSV is normalized into typed telemetry records. Header-only CSV and empty optional record arrays are valid; at least one work order is required.
shared_schema.common_output: Same canonical envelope with telemetry replacing telemetry_csv, status=ok, stage, and cumulatively appended documents/onboarding/insights sections.
shared_schema.identity: Unique IDs per collection; cross-references resolve to work orders, customer names are consistent, inspection lots and machine assets match.
shared_schema.validation: One validate gateway and validate_common layer at every stage; deterministic recomputation validates derived sections and preserves provenance. Finite non-boolean numbers, timezone-qualified timestamps, chronological sensor streams, strict units and physical/tolerance bounds.
shared_schema.tolerance_semantics: Inclusive min/max normal range, critical if value > safety_max; min <= max <= safety_max. Values outside operating tolerance but inside physical limits create alerts, not invalid input. Physical limits and thresholds are illustrative, not universal equipment rules.
shared_schema.quality_traceability: Inspection ID, work-order ID, lot, asset, customer, named decision maker, decision timestamp, rationale, measured value/unit and exact tolerance are retained. Accept/reject must agree with measured tolerance.
shared_schema.errors: CLI validation, JSON, encoding and file errors emit one JSON object with status=error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated normalized records, quality decision register and source-linked telemetry/inspection/maintenance alerts.
cross_stage_handoffs.consumption: Onboarding validates the entire documents state before creating personalized prioritized tasks, blocked customer states and one explicit next-step ID per customer.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated onboarding tasks/customer statuses plus preserved feedback, source alerts, orders and quality evidence.
cross_stage_handoffs.consumption: Insights validates the full onboarding state and groups feedback together with actionable task references, reporting negative feedback, affected customers/orders, blocked customers and human escalation counts.

behavior.documents: Extract CSV, reshape normalized records, enforce shared schema and traceability, produce alert evidence and quality-decision register.
behavior.onboarding: Prioritize critical safety then rejected quality then operational warnings then orientation; personalize instructions using customer, order, asset, operator and lot context.
behavior.insights: Deterministic multi-label keyword matching for safety, quality, maintenance and training, with other fallback; combine validated onboarding task signals into recommended human actions.
behavior.human_safety: Every critical alert produces a blocking awaiting_human task assigned to human_safety_lead. No automatic machine actions or production clearance. Resolved maintenance records remain in provenance but do not generate open alerts.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly marked synthetic telemetry, fictitious machines/customers/operators, and invented maintenance logs. Example nominal readings were generated with random.Random(61), temperature uniform(54,64) C and vibration uniform(1.8,3.3) mm/s; injected anomalies are 5.4 mm/s and 96.2 C. Tests also generate 40 seed-61 plausible samples.
behavior.determinism: No time-dependent logic, provider calls, randomness in the pipeline or persistent mutations. Sorted priorities and theme lists. Input and prior-stage objects are not mutated.
behavior.feedback_limits: Themes may overlap; unique feedback count remains separate from per-theme counts. Keyword matching is descriptive and cannot diagnose causality or infer actual customer sentiment beyond supplied labels.

included: Single integrated runnable CLI with versioned shared schema
Manufacturing document extraction, guided onboarding and customer insights
Human escalation for safety-critical sensor, inspection and open maintenance alerts
Input and cross-stage validation; JSON-only CLI success/error protocol
Synthetic unit, cross-stage, industry, edge and CLI test coverage
excluded: Compliance certification or complete ISO 9001 quality-management system
Actual equipment control, safety authorization, message delivery or human acknowledgement
Live ERP/MES integration, PDF/OCR ingestion, network or model providers
Production authentication, multi-user persistence, tamper-proof audit storage or scale guarantees
Statistical learning, causal analytics or automatic remediation

unit_tests.coverage: All stages, cross-stage provenance and tamper rejection, deterministic immutability, seed-generated telemetry, empty collections, identifiers, units, tolerance boundaries, physical limits, timestamps, quality traceability, safety escalation, feedback grouping, CLI success and errors.

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok and stage=insights
